stem: The graph of \( f(x) = x^2 \) is transformed to create the graph of \( h(x) = 2f(x) \). Which graph best represents \( f \) and \( h \)?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph with \( h \) as the wider parabola and \( f \) as the narrower parabola.

options.label: H
options.text: Graph with \( f \) as the wider parabola and \( h \) as the narrower parabola.

options.label: G
options.text: Graph with \( f \) as the narrower parabola and \( h \) as the wider parabola.

options.label: J
options.text: Graph with \( h \) as the narrower parabola and \( f \) as the wider parabola.

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled F, H, G, and J showing parabolas representing functions f and h with different widths and positions.
notes: The correct graph has h(x) = 2f(x) which vertically stretches the parabola f(x) = x^2, making h narrower than f.
